title.zh-TW: 以現金支付董監事酬勞
title.en: Pay remuneration of directors and supervisors in cash

summary.zh-TW: 以現金 {{money:param.amount}} 支付董監事酬勞。
summary.en: Pay {{money:param.amount}} in cash as remuneration of directors and supervisors.

message.zh-TW: 帳上現金不夠付這筆款項。
message.en: There is not enough cash on the books for this payment.

explanation.zh-TW: 付給董監事的酬勞是經營公司的費用，列在銷管費用；現金減少、獲利減少。現行報表多稱董事酬勞，教材沿用董監事酬勞。
explanation.en: Remuneration paid to directors and supervisors is a cost of running the company and belongs to distribution costs and administrative expenses; cash and profit both fall. Current financial statements usually call it directors' remuneration; the course keeps the older name covering supervisors too.
